items.title: 68516_Gene Ramey oral history interview
items.q: that famous guitarist, Freddie Green, does not flirt with the chords

ctx.x: Uh-huh. Yeah. Now if you'll notice in Basie's band, that famous guitarist, Freddie Green, does not flirt with the chords, if you understand what I mean. You know, chords can and follow progressions. Chords can stay just on the rudiments, and that way people know where you are, and they don't have to clash with you.
